definition_zh: 兴趣；利益；利息；v. 使感兴趣
definition_en: the feeling of wanting to know more about something, an advantage you gain, or money paid for the use of money
core_image: 一个人把头探过桌边，眼睛跟着别人手里的书页一起移动
scene: 少年挤在人群外圈，踮着脚看摊主手上的老式钟表，舍不得走。The bank pays a little interest on that account each month.
sceneCN: 这里 interest 是「兴趣」（第 1 个义项：想知道更多的心情），句意银行每月给那个账户付一点利息，用的是第 2 个义项。画面里的物件：老式钟表、踮起的脚、存折。

pos.zh: 名词：兴趣；利益；利息；股份
动词：使感兴趣；引起（某人）注意

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「有趣的」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「感兴趣的」
由 interesting 加 -ly 构成，义为「有趣的是」
由否定前缀 dis- 加过去分词构成，义为「不带私利的」

senses.title: Wanting to know more
senses.definition: a feeling of curiosity or attention that makes you want to know more about something
senses.definitionCN: 一种好奇或注意的心情，使你想对某事了解更多
senses.example: His interest in old watches began at a street market.
senses.exampleCN: 他对旧钟表的兴趣始于一个街头小市集。
senses.why: Latin interest means "it is between", that is, it makes a difference to someone.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interest 意为「它在其间」，即与人有关、对人有差别。

senses.title: Money paid for money
senses.definition: the money that a borrower pays to a lender for the use of the money over time
senses.definitionCN: 借用人因使用这笔钱而按时间付给放款人的钱
senses.example: A small loan at seven per cent interest adds up quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 百分之七利率的小额贷款很快就滚出不少钱。
senses.why: Roman law made it profitable to have a stake in a loan, and interest came to mean that stake.
senses.whyCN: 罗马法使在借贷中占一份成为有利可图之事，interest 遂指这「一份」。

senses.title: What is good for you
senses.definition: the advantage or benefit of a person or group
senses.definitionCN: 个人或团体的好处与得益
senses.example: The road was closed in the interest of safety.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路为了安全而被封闭。
senses.why: What makes a difference to you is also what serves your advantage.
senses.whyCN: 对你有差别的事，也就是对你有利的事。

senses.title: A share in a business
senses.definition: a legal share or stake in a company or property
senses.definitionCN: 在公司或财产中的合法份额
senses.example: She sold her interest in the shop to her partner.
senses.exampleCN: 她把店里的股份卖给了合伙人。
senses.why: From a stake in a loan the word widened to any ownership share.
senses.whyCN: 从借贷中的一份，此词扩展到任何所有权份额。

senses.title: To draw attention
senses.definition: to make someone want to know or take part
senses.definitionCN: 使某人想了解或参与
senses.example: The teacher interested the class in the old maps on the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 老师让全班对墙上的旧地图产生了兴趣。
senses.why: The verb reverses the noun: it plants the curiosity instead of feeling it.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词反过来用：不是产生好奇，而是种下好奇。

intro.en: Interest began as the Latin verb phrase interest "it makes a difference", from inter and esse "to be".
intro.cn: interest 起初是拉丁语动词短语 interest「与之有关」，由 inter 与 esse「存在」构成。

items.en: Interest is literally "it is between", used in phrases like interest reipublicae, it matters to the state.
items.cn: interest 字面是「它在中间」，见于 interest reipublicae 等短语，意谓对国家有干系。

items.en: Roman law compensated a lender for the delay in repayment, weighing what it mattered to him.
items.cn: 罗马法就延迟还款补偿放款人，衡量的正是此事对他有多大干系。

items.en: French interest narrowed to mean money paid for the use of money.
items.cn: 法语 interest 窄化为为使用金钱而付的钱。

items.en: English took interest in the sixteenth century for both money and advantage.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 interest，兼指利息与好处。

items.en: The sense of curiosity appeared later and became the commonest use of all.
items.cn: 「好奇」这一义项较晚出现，却成了最常见用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin verb esse "to be"; the near-meaning group holds other words for attention and money.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语动词 esse「存在」；近义组收表示注意与钱财的词。

entries.definition: The adjective for things that hold attention.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容能吸引注意的事物。

entries.definition: The adjective for the person who feels interest.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容感到兴趣的人。

entries.definition: Free from personal gain, not merely bored.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「无利害关系的」，并非「不感兴趣」。

entries.definition: The wish to know, without any stake.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「好奇心」，不带利益。

entries.definition: An advantage, especially as a right.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「益处」，尤指应得的权利。

entries.definition: Money made from a business after costs.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「利润」，扣除成本后的所赚。

normalIntro.en: The hooks run from the phrase "it matters to me" to the exact phrases interest lives in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从「这事与我有关」一路走到 interest 的真实搭配。

normal.en: Interest first meant "it is between": it stands between a person and a thing.
normal.cn: interest 最早意为「在其中间」：站在人与事物之间。

normal.en: Be interested in a topic, take an interest in a hobby.
normal.cn: 对话题用 be interested in，对爱好用 take an interest in。

normal.en: Interest on a loan is your stake in the lender's delay.
normal.cn: 贷款的利息就是你对放款人拖延所占的那一份。

normal.en: In the interest of safety, the road was closed.
normal.cn: 为了安全，这条路被封闭。

normal.en: A conflict of interest means two gains pull against each other.
normal.cn: 利益冲突指的是两份好处互相拉扯。

abstract.en: Interest is the thread that ties attention to advantage.
abstract.cn: 兴趣是把注意力与好处系在一起的那根线。

abstract.en: Money grows by interest; the mind grows by interest too.
abstract.cn: 钱靠利息增长，心也靠兴趣增长。

abstract.en: What matters to you will always hold your eyes.
abstract.cn: 与你有关的事总会牵住你的眼睛。

examples.en: Her interest in birds began with a single nest outside the window.
examples.cn: 她对鸟的兴趣始于窗外的一个鸟巢。

examples.en: The loan is repaid with interest over five years.
examples.cn: 这笔贷款在五年内连本带息还清。

examples.en: He acted in the interest of the whole village, not himself.
examples.cn: 他是为整个村子而非自己行事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因戳瑞斯特」——因被戳到痒处，立刻来了兴趣

root: 拉丁语 inter「在……之间」+ esse「存在」→ 动词短语 interest「与之有关」→ 古法语 interest → 英语 interest。同族：interesting、interested。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: curiosity, money for money, advantage, a share in a business, and the verb of arousing curiosity.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：好奇、钱生钱的利息、好处、生意里的份额，以及使人上心的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person leaning forward, eyes following someone else's book.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人探身向前，眼睛跟着别人手里的书走。

branches.en: THE MARKET STALL: curiosity makes the boy stop walking.
branches.cn: 小摊这条线：好奇心让少年停住脚。

branches.en: THE SAVINGS BOOK: money earns money over time.
branches.cn: 存折这条线：钱随时间再生钱。

branches.en: THE CLOSED ROAD: a benefit is weighed against a cost.
branches.cn: 封闭的路这条线：好处要与代价权衡。

branches.en: THE SOLD SHARE: ownership is the same stake in property.
branches.cn: 卖出的股份这条线：所有权即财产中的一份。

branches.en: THE OLD MAPS: a teacher plants the curiosity.
branches.cn: 旧地图这条线：老师把好奇种下去。

intro.en: Interest has no living prefix-and-suffix split in English: it is frozen Latin, inter "between" plus the verb "to be".
intro.cn: interest 在英语里已无活的词缀可分，是一块冻结的拉丁语：inter「在……之间」加「存在」动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin interest and the phrase interest reipublicae are recorded; only the deepest IE layer is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interest 与短语 interest reipublicae 均有记载，只有最深的印欧层是重构。

items.example: It places the matter among people.
items.exampleCN: 它把这件事安放在人与人之间。

items.example: The verb behind est and interest.
items.exampleCN: est 与 interest 背后的动词。

items.example: The frozen source of the English word.
It forms disinterested, free of gain.

definition_zh: 国际的；国际性的；国际比赛
definition_en: involving two or more countries, or belonging to the whole world rather than one nation
core_image: 一张长桌，桌边插着好几面不同颜色的国旗
scene: 会议厅里长桌两侧坐着不同语言的代表，同声传译耳机排成一行。The treaty became international law after the vote.
sceneCN: 这里 international 是「国际的」（第 1 个义项：涉及多个国家的），句意为表决之后该条约成了国际法。画面里的物件：长桌、国旗、传译耳机。

pos.zh: 形容词：国际的；国际性的
名词：国际比赛；国际组织成员

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「在国际上」
由本词加 -ism 构成，义为「国际主义」
由本词加 -ize 构成，义为「使国际化」
去前缀 nation 加 -al 构成，义为「国家的」

senses.title: Between nations
senses.definition: existing or happening between two or more countries
senses.definitionCN: 存在于或发生在两个以上国家之间的
senses.example: Both sides signed an international agreement on fishing rights.
senses.exampleCN: 双方签署了一份关于捕鱼权的国际协议。
senses.why: The prefix inter- means between, so the word literally places something between nations.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 意为「之间」，所以这个词字面上就是把某物放在各国之间。

senses.title: Open to many countries
senses.definition: made up of or open to people and groups from many nations
senses.definitionCN: 由许多国家的人或团体组成、或向他们开放的
senses.example: The orchestra has an international cast of players.
senses.exampleCN: 这个乐团的演奏者来自许多国家。
senses.why: If something lies between nations, it naturally gathers people from all of them.
senses.whyCN: 既然位于各国之间，自然就会把各国的人都聚到一起。

senses.title: Competition or body
senses.definition: a match between national teams, or an organization with member states
senses.definitionCN: 国家代表队之间的比赛，或有成员国参加的组织
senses.example: He won three internationals before he turned twenty.
senses.exampleCN: 他二十岁前赢了三场国际比赛。
senses.why: As a noun the adjective needed no new shape: the games themselves became internationals.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时形容词不必变形：这类比赛就被叫作 internationals。

intro.en: International was coined in English in the late eighteenth century by adding inter- to national.
intro.cn: international 是十八世纪晚期英语在 national 前加 inter- 新造的词。

items.en: Inter meant "between" and nasci "to be born".
items.cn: inter 意为「之间」，nasci 意为「出生」。

items.en: Nation entered French from Latin natio, a people born together.
items.cn: nation 从拉丁语 natio「同出生的一群人」进入法语。

items.en: English used national for what belongs to one people.
items.cn: 英语用 national 表示属于一个民族或国家的。

items.en: Jeremy Bentham coined international for law that binds nations.
items.cn: 杰里米·边沁造出 international，指约束各国的法律。

items.en: From law the word spread to trade, sport, and organizations.
items.cn: 这个词从法律扩展到贸易、体育与各类组织。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the same inter- and nat- parts; the near-meaning group holds words about worldwide scale.
note.cn: 形近组共用 inter- 与 nat- 两部分；近义组收表示全球范围的词。

entries.definition: Belonging to one country only.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「国家的；民族的」，只属于一国。

entries.definition: Happening inside one country or object.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「内部的」，强调在内部。

entries.definition: A period of time between two events.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「间隔」，指两事之间的时间。

entries.definition: Covering the whole world as a single unit.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「全球的」，强调整体范围。

entries.definition: Spread through every part of the world.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「遍及全世界的」。

entries.definition: Operating in several countries at once.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「跨国的」，指同时在多国运作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks break the word into pieces you already know.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它拆成你早已熟悉的几块。

normal.en: inter- means between; national means of a nation.
normal.cn: inter- 是「之间」，national 是「国家的」。

normal.en: Put them together: what sits between nations.
normal.cn: 合起来：坐在各国之间的东西。

normal.en: An international airport serves flights from other countries.
normal.cn: 国际机场接待来自别国的航班。

normal.en: Drop inter- and you are back to one country.
normal.cn: 去掉 inter- 就退回一个国家。

normal.en: The word was born in law, not in sport.
normal.cn: 这个词先在法律里出生，而不是体育。

abstract.en: International is the gap turned into a meeting room.
abstract.cn: 国际就是那道缝隙被改造成一间会议室。

abstract.en: A border is a line; international is what crosses it.
abstract.cn: 边界是一条线；国际是跨过这条线的一切。

abstract.en: Many flags, one word on the door.
abstract.cn: 许多面国旗，门牌上只写一个词。

examples.en: She works for an international charity in Geneva.
examples.cn: 她在日内瓦一家国际慈善机构工作。

examples.en: International calls cost extra on that plan.
examples.cn: 那个套餐里国际长途要另外收费。

examples.en: The match was his first international at this level.
examples.cn: 这场比赛是他在这一级别的首次国际赛事。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ nation（国家）+ al——国家之间的

root: 拉丁语 inter「之间」+ natio「出生、族群」→ 古法语 nation → 英语 national → 加 inter- 成 international。同族有 nation、national、internationally。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: between nations, made of many nations, and as a noun for big matches or bodies.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：国与国之间的、由多国组成的，以及作名词指国际赛事或组织。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a room where more than one flag stands at the table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张桌边立着不止一面国旗的房间。

branches.en: THE TREATY: agreements that bind more than one state.
branches.cn: 条约这条线：约束不止一个国家的协定。

branches.en: THE TEAM: people drawn from many countries.
branches.cn: 团队这条线：来自许多国家的人。

branches.en: THE FIXTURE: a match or a body named for its scope.
branches.cn: 赛事这条线：以范围命名的比赛或组织。

branches.en: THE FRAME: both senses hang on what lies beyond one border.
branches.cn: 框架线：两个义项都挂在同一条边界之外。

branches.en: THE STAGE: a shared stage makes both the team and the match possible.
branches.cn: 舞台线：共用的舞台让团队与比赛都成为可能。

intro.en: International is inter- "between" plus national, where nat- means born.
intro.cn: international 是 inter-「之间」加 national，其中 nat- 意为「出生」。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter and natio are recorded; the verb nasci is the oldest member.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 与 natio 均有记载，动词 nasci 是这一族最古老的成员。

items.example: It marks what sits between two sides.
items.exampleCN: 它标出位于两侧之间的东西。

items.example: The root also appears in native and nature.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 native 与 nature。

items.example: The noun grew into the modern nation.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词演变成现代的 nation。

items.example: It makes national out of nation.
items.exampleCN: 它把 nation 变成 national。

items.example: The noun names one political community.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指一个政治共同体。

items.example: The word adds inter- to this adjective.
items.exampleCN: 本词就是在这个形容词前加 inter-。

definition_zh: 面试；采访；面谈
definition_en: a meeting in which someone is asked questions, either to judge them for a job or to get their views for the public
core_image: 两张椅子面对面摆着，中间只有一台录音机
scene: 写字楼的小间里，桌子两侧各坐一人，桌上摊着一份简历和一支笔。The interview lasted barely twenty minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 interview 是「面试」（第 1 个义项：为判断是否录用而进行的问答），句意为那场面试只持续了不到二十分钟。画面里的物件：简历、录音笔、两张椅子。

pos.zh: 名词：面试；采访；面谈
动词：对……进行面试；采访

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「面试官；采访者」
由本词加 -ee 构成，义为「受面试者；受访者」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「面试工作；访谈方法」

senses.title: Questions for a job
senses.definition: a formal meeting where an employer asks a candidate questions to judge their suitability
senses.definitionCN: 雇主向候选人提问以判断其是否适合的正式会面
senses.example: Her interview at the bank is on Friday morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她在银行的面试定在周五上午。
senses.why: The prefix inter- means between and videre means to see, so the word first meant seeing each other face to face.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 意为「之间」，videre 意为「看见」，所以本义是「彼此见面」。

senses.title: Questions for the public
senses.definition: a conversation in which a journalist asks someone questions for print or broadcast
senses.definitionCN: 记者为报刊或广播电视向某人提问的对谈
senses.example: The singer gave a long interview about her new record.
senses.exampleCN: 这位歌手就新专辑接受了一次长采访。
senses.why: Journalism reused the face-to-face meeting and turned it into published words.
senses.whyCN: 新闻业借用这种面对面见面，把它变成发表出来的文字。

senses.title: The verb of asking
senses.definition: to ask someone questions in such a meeting, or to be asked them
senses.definitionCN: 在此类会面中向某人提问，或接受提问
senses.example: They interviewed six people for the post.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为这个职位面试了六个人。
senses.why: English turned the noun into a verb without changing its shape.
senses.whyCN: 英语把这个名词直接转成动词，形式不变。

senses.title: A private talk
senses.definition: a formal private meeting between parties who need to exchange views
senses.definitionCN: 需要交换看法者之间的正式私下会面
senses.example: The minister granted an interview to the delegation.
senses.exampleCN: 部长接见了代表团并与之会谈。
senses.why: The word also keeps its neutral sense of two parties meeting to talk.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也保留了「两方会面交谈」这一中性义。

intro.en: Interview joins Latin inter- "between" and videre "to see": a meeting face to face.
intro.cn: interview 把拉丁语 inter-「之间」与 videre「看见」合起来：一次面对面的会面。

items.en: Entreveue in French meant a meeting where people see each other.
items.cn: 法语的 entreveue 指彼此见面的会晤。

items.en: English borrowed interview in the sixteenth century for a formal meeting.
items.cn: 英语十六世纪借入 interview，指正式会晤。

items.en: Newspapers turned the meeting into a published question-and-answer.
items.cn: 报纸把这种会面变成刊登出来的问答。

items.en: Employers borrowed it for judging job candidates.
items.cn: 雇主借用它指对求职者的考察。

items.en: Broadcasting made the interview a household word.
items.cn: 广播电视让 interview 成为家喻户晓的词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -view root of seeing; the near-meaning group holds kinds of talk.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -view「看见」词根；近义组收各类谈话。

entries.definition: To look again at something in order to judge.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「复查；评论」。

entries.definition: What can be seen, or an opinion.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「景色；看法」。

entries.definition: The person being asked the questions.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「受访者；受面试者」。

entries.definition: An informal talk between people.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「交谈」，语气随意。

entries.definition: A short test performance for a role.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「试演」，偏艺术行当。

entries.definition: A formal session where evidence is heard.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「听证会」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the face-to-face picture of two people looking at each other.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守着「两个人面对面看着对方」的画面。

normal.en: inter- between plus view see equals seeing each other.
normal.cn: inter-「之间」加 view「看」就是彼此相见。

normal.en: A job interview is a view of you taken from across a desk.
normal.cn: 求职面试就是隔着桌子取你的一张「看法」。

normal.en: The boss interviews; the candidate is interviewed.
normal.cn: 老板面试别人，候选人被面试。

normal.en: Magazines print the interview as questions and answers.
normal.cn: 杂志把采访印成问答。

normal.en: View also lives in review and preview.
normal.cn: view 也活在 review 与 preview 里。

abstract.en: An interview is a short, formal version of being known.
abstract.cn: 面试是「被了解」这件事的简短正式版。

abstract.en: Two strangers look at each other and call it seeing.
abstract.cn: 两个陌生人互相打量，然后管这叫「看见」。

abstract.en: The room is small because the stakes are large.
abstract.cn: 房间很小，是因为赌注很大。

examples.en: He prepared for the interview by reading the company report.
examples.cn: 他为面试做了准备，读了公司的报告。

examples.en: The paper published a rare interview with the coach.
examples.cn: 报纸刊登了这位教练少有的专访。

examples.en: They will interview three more applicants tomorrow.
examples.cn: 他们明天还要面试另外三名申请者。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ view（看）——彼此当着面看一看

root: 拉丁语 inter「之间」+ videre「看见」→ 古法语 entreveue「会面」→ 英语 interview。同族有 interviewer、interviewee、review。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: a job interview, a media interview, the verb of asking, and a formal private meeting.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：求职面试、媒体采访、提问这个动作，以及正式私下会晤。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two chairs facing each other with nothing but a recorder between.
core.cn: 核心意象：两张面对面的椅子，中间只放一台录音机。

branches.en: THE DESK: an employer weighs a candidate.
branches.cn: 办公桌这条线：雇主掂量候选人。

branches.en: THE MICROPHONE: a journalist gathers words for print.
branches.cn: 话筒这条线：记者为刊登收集话语。

branches.en: THE QUESTION: the act of asking itself.
branches.cn: 问题这条线：提问这个动作。

branches.en: THE DOOR: a formal private meeting of two sides.
branches.cn: 门口这条线：两方的正式私下会面。

branches.en: THE LINK: both are controlled talk with a purpose.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都是有目的、被掌控的谈话。

intro.en: Interview is inter- "between" plus the Latin root vid- "see", with the French participle ending.
intro.cn: interview 是 inter-「之间」加拉丁词根 vid-「看见」，词尾来自法语分词。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre is recorded, and French entreveue is its medieval meeting form.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 有记载，法语 entreveue 是它中世纪的会面形式。

items.exampleCN: 它标出相互之间的位置。

items.example: The root also appears in vision and evident.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 vision 与 evident。

items.example: The verb is the base of the root.
The French noun is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个法语名词是直接来源。

items.example: It forms review, to see again.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 review，意为再看一次。

items.example: It forms preview, to see beforehand.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 preview，意为预先看到。

definition_zh: 到……里面；进入；变成；对……
definition_en: moving to a position inside something, changing to a new state, or showing direction of attention
core_image: 一支箭正穿过门框，箭头已经进到屋子里面
scene: 孩子端着热汤从厨房走到客厅，小心地跨过门槛。She walked into the room without knocking.
sceneCN: 这里 into 是「到……里面」（第 1 个义项：向内的移动），句意为她没敲门就走进了房间。画面里的物件：门槛、端着的汤碗、门框。

pos.zh: 介词：到……里面；进入；变成；对……

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀 to 构成，义为「在……里面」
结构平行的词，义为「到……上面」
功能相近的方位介词，义为「朝向」

senses.title: Movement to the inside
senses.definition: to a position inside a place, container, or space
senses.definitionCN: 到一个地方、容器或空间的里面
senses.example: He poured the milk into a tall glass.
senses.exampleCN: 他把牛奶倒进一只高玻璃杯里。
senses.why: In names the position; to names the movement. Into fuses both in one word.
senses.whyCN: in 表示位置，to 表示移动；into 把两者合成一个词。

senses.title: A change of state
senses.definition: showing the result of a change from one state or form to another
senses.definitionCN: 表示从一种状态或形态变成另一种的结果
senses.example: The water froze into solid ice overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 水一夜之间冻成了坚冰。
senses.why: Change is pictured as entering a new container called a state.
senses.whyCN: 变化被想象成走进一个叫「状态」的新容器。

senses.title: Collision or contact
senses.definition: showing that something strikes or meets something else
senses.definitionCN: 表示某物撞到或遇到另一物
senses.example: The car ran into the fence at the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 汽车在拐角处撞上了栅栏。
senses.why: Running into a thing means moving into the space it fills.
senses.whyCN: run into 某物，就是进入它占据的那块空间。

senses.title: Interest and attention
senses.definition: showing what someone is interested in or is examining closely
senses.definitionCN: 表示某人感兴趣或正在仔细查看的对象
senses.example: She is really into old films these days.
senses.exampleCN: 她最近非常迷老电影。
senses.why: Attention is also movement: the mind goes into whatever it studies.
senses.whyCN: 注意力也是一种移动：心走进它所研究的东西。

intro.en: Into is a native English compound of in and to, first written as two words.
intro.cn: into 是英语本土词，由 in 与 to 合成，最初写作两个词。

items.en: In and to were separate words with separate jobs.
items.cn: in 与 to 是两个各司其职的独立词。

items.en: Writers placed them side by side for movement inward.
items.cn: 写作者把它们并排放在一起表示向内的移动。

items.en: The two were written as one word in the medieval period.
items.cn: 中世纪时期这两个词被写成一个词。

items.en: Into became the standard form for motion and change.
items.cn: into 成为表示移动与变化的标准形式。

items.en: Idioms such as run into and be into widened its range.
items.cn: run into 与 be into 等习语又扩大了它的用法。

note.en: The look-alike group holds other small prepositions of place; the near-meaning group holds older motion words.
note.cn: 形近组收其他表方位的小介词；近义组收较古的移动词。

entries.definition: Position inside, not movement.
entries.definitionCN: 介词义为「在……里面」，表位置。

entries.definition: An archaic form meaning to or toward.
entries.definitionCN: 介词义为「向」，古旧用法。

entries.definition: Movement to a position on a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 介词义为「到……上面」。

entries.definition: Within the limits of something.
entries.definitionCN: 介词义为「在……之内」，语气更实。

entries.definition: In the direction of, without entering.
entries.definitionCN: 介词义为「朝向」，不含进入。

entries.definition: Inside a space or a period of time.
entries.definitionCN: 介词义为「在……之内」，偏书面。

normalIntro.en: These hooks treat the word as in plus to walking through a door.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把这个词看成 in 加 to 一起穿过一道门。

normal.en: Into is simply in and to run together.
normal.cn: into 就是 in 与 to 并在一起。

normal.en: In is where you are; into is how you got there.
normal.cn: in 是你在哪，into 是你怎么进去的。

normal.en: Change also uses into: ice into water, paper into ash.
normal.cn: 变化也用 into：冰成水、纸成灰。

normal.en: Run into someone means meet them by accident.
normal.cn: run into someone 意思是偶然碰上。

normal.en: Be into a band means the band is where your mind goes.
normal.cn: be into a band 意思是心都往那支乐队里去。

abstract.en: Into is a word shaped like a doorway.
abstract.cn: into 是一个长得像门口的词。

abstract.en: Every change of state is a small migration inward.
abstract.cn: 每一次状态转变都是一次向内的迁徙。

abstract.en: We fall into habits as easily as into chairs.
abstract.cn: 我们掉进习惯，就像落进椅子那么自然。

examples.en: The cat slipped into the box and refused to come out.
examples.cn: 猫钻进箱子，怎么也不肯出来。

examples.en: The argument turned into a long silence.
examples.cn: 那场争论最后变成了长久的沉默。

examples.en: He is into repairing old bicycles.
examples.cn: 他很热衷于修旧自行车。

dict_mnemonic.text: in（里面）+ to（朝）——朝着里面去

root: 古英语 in「在内」+ to「向」→ 中世纪合写为 into，表示向内的移动与状态变化。同族有 in、inside、unto。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: motion inside, change of state, collision, and direction of interest.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：向内的移动、状态变化、相撞，以及兴趣所指。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow already halfway through a doorway.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支箭已穿过门框一半。

branches.en: THE CUP: liquid moving to the inside of a container.
branches.cn: 杯子这条线：液体移进容器内部。

branches.en: THE ICE: one state becoming another.
branches.cn: 冰这条线：一种状态变成另一种。

branches.en: THE FENCE: a moving thing meets a solid thing.
branches.cn: 栅栏这条线：运动之物撞上实体。

branches.en: THE RECORD: attention travelling to a favourite subject.
branches.cn: 唱片这条线：注意力移向偏爱的主题。

branches.en: THE LINK: both read an abstract space as a room to enter.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都把抽象空间当成可进的房间。

intro.en: Into has no Latin pieces: it is the native in joined to to.
intro.cn: into 没有拉丁成分：它是本土的 in 接上 to。

latinIntro.en: This word is Germanic, so there are no Latin entries to list here.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语，故此处无须列出拉丁词条。

items.example: It names the direction of travel.
The compound carries both ideas at once.
items.exampleCN: 这个合成词同时带着两个意思。

items.example: The same pattern with on instead of in.
items.exampleCN: 同一结构，把 in 换成 on。

items.example: An older form that lost ground.
It names the inner space itself.
items.exampleCN: 它指里面那块空间本身。

items.example: It keeps the direction without the entry.

items.exampleCN: 它是 in 的书面表亲。

definition_zh: 介绍；引进；提出；开始
definition_en: to tell people someone's name, to bring something in for the first time, or to begin something
core_image: 一个人牵着另一个人的手，把他领进一间坐满陌生人的屋子
scene: 晚宴开始时，主人走到客人身边，把他们两两凑在一起说名字。They introduced the new system last spring.
sceneCN: 这里 introduce 是「引进、推行」（第 2 个义项：把新事物带入使用），句意为他们去年春天引进了这套新系统。画面里的物件：晚宴长桌、香槟杯、贴着新标签的控制台。

pos.zh: 动词：介绍；引进；提出；作为……的开头

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -tion 构成，义为「介绍；引进；前言」
由本词加 -ory 构成，义为「引导性的；入门的」
由本词截短构成，义为「引言；开场」
同出 duc- 词根，义为「教育的」

senses.title: Make two people known
senses.definition: to tell two people each other's names so that they can begin to know each other
senses.definitionCN: 说出两人的名字，使他们可以开始相识
senses.example: Let me introduce my sister before we sit down.
senses.exampleCN: 坐下之前让我介绍一下我妹妹。
senses.why: Latin ducere means to lead; intro- means inward. To introduce is to lead someone in.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ducere 意为「引导」，intro- 意为「向内」，introduce 就是把人领进来。

senses.title: Bring something in
senses.definition: to bring a new thing, idea, or rule into use for the first time
senses.definitionCN: 首次把新事物、新想法或新规定投入使用
senses.example: The school introduced a later start for older pupils.
senses.exampleCN: 学校为高年级学生推出了更晚的到校时间。
senses.why: The leading-in picture suits ideas too: new rules are walked into a system.
senses.whyCN: 「领进来」的图像也适用于想法：新规定被领进一个体系。

senses.title: Become familiar with
senses.definition: to cause someone to experience or learn about something for the first time
senses.definitionCN: 使某人第一次接触或了解某事物
senses.example: Her aunt introduced her to jazz when she was ten.
senses.exampleCN: 她十岁时，姑母带她第一次接触爵士乐。
senses.why: Here the person is led into a subject as if into a room.
senses.whyCN: 这里人是被领进一门学问，就像被领进一间屋子。

senses.title: Begin a piece
senses.definition: to begin a speech, book, or programme with something
senses.definitionCN: 用某内容作为演讲、书籍或节目的开头
senses.example: The chair introduced the meeting with two minutes of thanks.
senses.exampleCN: 主席用两分钟致谢作为会议的开场。
senses.why: Opening a meeting is leading the audience in, so the same verb serves.
senses.whyCN: 会议开场就是把听众领进来，所以还是用同一个动词。

intro.en: Introduce joins Latin intro- "inward" and ducere "to lead": to lead someone in.
intro.cn: introduce 把拉丁语 intro-「向内」与 ducere「引导」结合：把人领进来。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead or draw along.
items.cn: ducere 意为带领或牵引。

items.en: Introducere meant to lead a person or thing inside.
items.cn: introducere 意为把人或物领进去。

items.en: French introduire kept the ceremonial sense of bringing someone in.
items.cn: 法语 introduire 保留了把人带进来的礼仪义。

items.en: English used introduce for presenting a person at court or at home.
items.cn: 英语用 introduce 指在宫廷或家中引见某人。

items.en: Industry and law added the sense of putting a new thing into use.
items.cn: 工业与法律又添上「把新事物投入使用」义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -duce leading root; the near-meaning group holds other words for presenting.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -duce「引导」词根；近义组收其他表示「推出」的词。

entries.definition: The act or the opening section that results.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「介绍；引言」。

entries.definition: To lead something back or make it smaller.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「减少」，同出 ducere。

entries.definition: To lead something forward into being.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「生产」，同出 ducere。

entries.definition: To show or hand over something formally.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「呈现；呈交」，更正式。

entries.definition: To start using something new.
entries.definitionCN: 动词短语义为「引入」，偏口语。

entries.definition: To start a product or campaign publicly.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「推出；发起」，强调公开。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the picture of a hand leading another person indoors.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守着「一只手把别人领进屋里」的画面。

normal.en: intro- inward plus duc lead equals lead in.
normal.cn: intro-「向内」加 duc「引导」等于「领进来」。

normal.en: The same duc root appears in reduce, produce, and conduct.
normal.cn: 同一个 duc 词根出现在 reduce、produce、conduct 里。

normal.en: Introduce yourself is the shortest formal speech you will give.
normal.cn: introduce yourself 是你要讲的最短的正式发言。

normal.en: Schools introduce rules the way hosts introduce guests.
normal.cn: 学校推行规定，就像主人介绍客人。

normal.en: Her aunt introduced her to jazz: led her into a room of sound.
normal.cn: 姑母带她认识爵士：把她领进一间装满声音的屋子。

abstract.en: To introduce is to open a door and stand aside.
abstract.cn: 介绍就是打开一扇门，然后退到一边。

abstract.en: New ideas also need someone to walk them in.
abstract.cn: 新想法也需要有人牵着走进去。

abstract.en: The word is a handshake turned into grammar.
abstract.cn: 这个词是把一次握手写成了语法。

examples.en: She introduced me to her old teacher at the gate.
examples.cn: 她在门口把我介绍给了她的老师。

examples.en: The company introduced a shorter working week.
examples.cn: 公司推行了更短的工作周。

examples.en: He introduced his talk with a story about his father.
examples.cn: 他用一个关于父亲的故事开了讲座的头。

dict_mnemonic.text: intro（向内）+ duce（引导）——把人领进门

root: 拉丁语 intro「向内」+ ducere「引导」→ introducere「领进去」→ 古法语 introduire → 英语 introduce。同族有 introduction、introductory、produce。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: make people known, bring something new in, lead someone into a subject, and open a piece.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：让人相识、引进新事物、带人入门，以及作为开场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand leading another person through a doorway.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手牵着另一个人穿过门口。

branches.en: THE NAMES: two strangers given to each other.
branches.cn: 名字这条线：两个陌生人被交给彼此。

branches.en: THE RULE: a new practice led into a system.
branches.cn: 规定这条线：新做法被领进一个体系。

branches.en: THE RECORD: a young listener led into jazz.
branches.cn: 唱片这条线：年轻听者被领进爵士。

branches.en: THE PODIUM: an opening line that leads the audience in.
branches.cn: 讲台这条线：把听众领进来的开场白。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses bring someone into a place they did not know.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都把某人带进他原本不认识的地方。

intro.en: Introduce is intro- "inward" plus the root duc- "lead" with the verb ending.
intro.cn: introduce 是 intro-「向内」加词根 duc-「引导」与动词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere, introducere and the participle introductus are recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ducere、introducere 与分词 introductus 均有记载。

items.example: It marks the direction of leading.
The root also appears in conduct and educate.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 conduct 与 educate。

items.example: The verb is the base of the root.
The verb is the direct source.
It forms reduce, to lead back.
It forms produce, to lead forth.

definition_zh: 介绍；引进；引言；入门
definition_en: the act of making people known or bringing something in, or the opening part of a book or talk
core_image: 书的正文之前，有一页写着短短几段，把你领进门
scene: 新同事被带到办公区，组长领着他在每张桌前停下说一句。The book's introduction explains why the author began.
sceneCN: 这里 introduction 是「引言、前言」（第 4 个义项：书或讲话的开头部分），句意为这本书的引言说明了作者为何动笔。画面里的物件：新同事、工位、书的扉页。

pos.zh: 名词：介绍；引进；引言；入门介绍

derivatives.zh: 去后缀构成，义为「介绍；引进」
由 introduce 加 -ory 构成，义为「引导性的」
截短形式，义为「开场；引言」

senses.title: Making people known
senses.definition: the act of telling two people each other's names so that they can meet
senses.definitionCN: 说出两人名字使他们得以相识的行为
senses.example: A quiet introduction at the door saved them both embarrassment.
senses.exampleCN: 门口一句轻轻的介绍替两人都免了尴尬。
senses.why: The Latin action noun treats the handshake as a deed with a name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语的动作名词把这次握手当成一件有名字的事。

senses.title: Bringing something in
senses.definition: the act of putting a new thing, rule, or idea into use
senses.definitionCN: 把新事物、规定或想法投入使用的行为
senses.example: The introduction of the railway changed the whole valley.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路的引进改变了整个山谷。
senses.why: The same leading-in image applies to machines and policies.
senses.whyCN: 「领进来」的图像同样用于机器与政策。

senses.title: A first course
senses.definition: a book or course that teaches the basics of a subject
senses.definitionCN: 讲解某学科基础知识的一本书或一门课
senses.example: This little grammar is a gentle introduction to Latin.
senses.exampleCN: 这本薄薄的语法书是拉丁语的温和入门。
senses.why: A beginner is led in, so the teaching material takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 初学者是被领进去的，于是入门教材也叫这个名字。

senses.title: The opening part
senses.definition: the first section of a book, speech, or piece of music
senses.definitionCN: 书籍、演讲或乐曲的最初部分
senses.example: Read the introduction before you judge the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 先读引言，再评判论证。
senses.why: The opening leads the reader in, exactly what the Latin verb described.
senses.whyCN: 开头把读者领进去，正是那个拉丁动词所描述的。

intro.en: Introduction is the Latin noun on introducere, to lead someone in.
intro.cn: introduction 是建立在 introducere（把人领进来）上的拉丁语名词。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead; intro- meant inward.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导」，intro- 意为「向内」。

items.en: Introductio named the act of bringing someone or something in.
items.cn: introductio 指把人或物带进来的行为。

items.en: French kept the noun for a formal presentation of persons.
items.cn: 法语保留了这个名词，指对人的正式引见。

items.en: Printing gave it the sense of the opening pages of a book.
items.cn: 印刷术给了它「书的开篇」义。

items.en: Modern usage adds the introduction of machines and reforms.
items.cn: 现代用法又添上机器与改革的引进。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -duct- leading stem; the near-meaning group holds other opening words.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -duct-「引导」词干；近义组收其他「开头」词。

entries.definition: The verb of leading someone in.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「介绍；引进」。

entries.definition: The adjective for an opening section.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「引导性的」。

entries.definition: The making of goods or a show.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「生产；制作」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: A short note before the main text.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「序言」，作者自述写作缘由。

entries.definition: An opening note often written by someone else.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「前言」，多由他人撰写。

entries.definition: A general summary before the details.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「概述」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks treat the word as the doorway into a book or a group.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它当作一本书或一群人的门口。

normal.en: Introduce is the act; introduction is the act turned into a thing.
normal.cn: introduce 是动作，introduction 是被做成东西的动作。

normal.en: An introduction to economics leads you into the subject.
normal.cn: an introduction to economics 把你领进这门学科。

normal.en: Letters of introduction once opened doors in a new city.
normal.cn: 介绍信曾在陌生城市替你开门。

normal.en: The introduction of the railway is the same word used for machines.
normal.cn: the introduction of the railway 是同词用于机器。

normal.en: Skip the introduction and you may miss why the book exists.
normal.cn: 跳过引言可能就错过了这本书存在的理由。

abstract.en: An introduction is a corridor, not a room.
abstract.cn: 引言是走廊，不是房间。

abstract.en: Every introduction asks you to trust before you know.
abstract.cn: 每次介绍都在你了解之前先请你信任。

abstract.en: A good introduction hands you a lamp, not a map.
abstract.cn: 好的引言递给你一盏灯，而不是一张地图。

examples.en: His introduction to her was made by a mutual friend.
examples.cn: 他是通过一位共同的朋友认识她的。

examples.en: The introduction of parking fees angered local shops.
examples.cn: 停车费的引入让本地商铺不满。

examples.en: She wrote a short introduction to the second edition.
examples.cn: 她为第二版写了一篇简短的引言。

dict_mnemonic.text: intro（向内）+ duct（引导）+ ion——把人领进来的那段

root: 拉丁语 intro「向内」+ ducere「引导」→ introductio「引见」→ 古法语 → 英语 introduction。同族有 introduce、introductory、intro。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: making people known, bringing something new in, a beginner's course, and an opening section.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：让人相识、引进新事物、入门课程，以及开篇部分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a few short pages standing before the main text like a doorman.
core.cn: 核心意象：正文之前几页短文，像一个门房站在那里。

branches.en: THE HANDSHAKE: two people given each other's names.
branches.cn: 握手这条线：两个人被互相报出名字。

branches.en: THE RAILWAY: a new thing led into daily life.
branches.cn: 铁路这条线：新事物被领进日常生活。

branches.en: THE TEXTBOOK: a gentle first course.
branches.cn: 课本这条线：温和的第一课。

branches.en: THE PREFACE: the opening that explains the whole.
branches.cn: 序言这条线：解释全书的开头。

branches.en: THE LINK: both stand at a door and say what comes next.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都站在门口，说明接下来是什么。

intro.en: Introduction is intro- plus the root duct- "lead" and the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: introduction 由 intro- 加词根 duct-「引导」与名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin introductio and the participle introductus are recorded forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 introductio 与分词 introductus 都是记载形式。

items.example: It marks the direction of entry.
The root also appears in conduct and product.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 conduct 与 product。

items.example: The noun is the direct source.
The verb is the base of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是名词的基础。
它构成 preface，意为先说在前。

items.example: It builds foreword, the word in front.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 foreword，即前面的文字。

definition_zh: 邀请；请柬；招致
definition_en: a spoken or written request to come somewhere or take part in something
core_image: 一张带香气的卡片被递到手里，上面写着日期和一句话：请来
scene: 邻居敲门，把一张手写卡片递过来，笑着说周末来吃饭。She accepted the invitation without hesitating.
sceneCN: 这里 invitation 是「邀请」（第 1 个义项：请人前来的请求），句意为她毫不犹豫地接受了邀请。画面里的物件：手写卡片、门框、信封。

pos.zh: 名词：邀请；请柬；招致

derivatives.zh: 去后缀构成，义为「邀请；招致」
由 invite 加 -ing 构成，义为「诱人的」
由 invitation 加 -al 构成，义为「邀请赛的」
加前缀 un- 构成，义为「不请自来的」

senses.title: A request to come
senses.definition: a request asking someone politely to come to a place or event
senses.definitionCN: 礼貌地请某人前来某地或参加某活动的请求
senses.example: We got an invitation to their wedding in the post.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在邮件里收到了他们婚礼的邀请。
senses.why: Latin invitare meant to ask someone in, and the noun names the asking.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 invitare 意为请人进来，名词指这次邀请。

senses.title: The card itself
senses.definition: the written or printed card that carries such a request
senses.definitionCN: 承载这种请求的书面或印刷卡片
senses.example: The invitation is on the fridge door.
senses.exampleCN: 那张请柬贴在冰箱门上。
senses.why: The paper takes the name of the message it carries.
senses.whyCN: 那张纸随它所承载的话语得了同一个名字。

senses.title: An open opportunity
senses.definition: a chance offered to someone to do or say something
senses.definitionCN: 给予某人做事或说话的机会
senses.example: The pause was an invitation to ask questions.
senses.exampleCN: 那阵停顿等于请人提问。
senses.why: Anything that says come in counts, even silence.
senses.whyCN: 凡是表达「请进」的都算，连沉默也算。

senses.title: Something that attracts harm
senses.definition: a situation or act that seems to encourage something bad
senses.definitionCN: 似乎会招来坏事的行为或状况
senses.example: Leaving the gate open was an invitation to thieves.
senses.exampleCN: 把大门敞着等于招贼。
senses.why: Here the inviting picture turns against the host.
senses.whyCN: 在这里，「邀请」的画面反过来指向主人自己。

intro.en: Invitation comes from Latin invitare, to ask someone in or to treat them as a guest.
intro.cn: invitation 来自拉丁语 invitare，意为请人进来或把对方当客人。

items.en: Invitare meant to invite or to entertain a guest.
items.cn: invitare 意为邀请或款待客人。

items.en: The noun invitatio named the welcoming itself.
items.cn: 名词 invitatio 指这番欢迎。

items.en: French invitation carried the social sense to English.
items.cn: 法语 invitation 把这个社交义带入英语。

items.en: Printed cards made the invitation a thing you keep.
items.cn: 印刷卡片使邀请成为可留存的实物。

items.en: The word also took the darker sense of courting trouble.
items.cn: 这个词也沾上「招来麻烦」的阴暗义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the invit- stem; the near-meaning group holds other social words.
note.cn: 形近组共用 invit- 词干；近义组收其他社交用词。

entries.definition: The verb of asking someone to come.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「邀请」。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning attractive or tempting.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「诱人的」。

entries.definition: The person who is invited.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「受邀者」，与 invitation 拼写相近。

entries.definition: Something presented for acceptance or refusal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「提议」，可接受也可拒绝。

entries.definition: The act of asking for something politely.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「请求」，不一定含欢迎。

entries.definition: An official order to appear.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「传唤」，带有强制。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the picture of a card handed over at the door.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守着「在门口递出一张卡片」的画面。

normal.en: Invite is the verb; invitation is the paper or the words.
normal.cn: invite 是动词，invitation 是那张纸或那番话。

normal.en: Accept, decline, and by invitation only are its three standard partners.
normal.cn: accept、decline、by invitation only 是它的三个固定搭档。

normal.en: An open invitation welcomes you at any time.
normal.cn: an open invitation 是随时欢迎你的邀请。

normal.en: An invitation to trouble is no welcome at all.
normal.cn: an invitation to trouble 根本不是欢迎。

normal.en: Inviting looks inviting, but the noun is about being asked.
normal.cn: inviting 形似 invitation，但名词讲的是被请。

abstract.en: An invitation is a door held open by someone else.
abstract.cn: 邀请是别人替你撑住的门。

abstract.en: To decline an invitation is to close it gently.
abstract.cn: 谢绝邀请是把那扇门轻轻合上。

abstract.en: Some doors invite you in and let the cold follow.
abstract.cn: 有些门请你进去，也把寒冷放了进来。

examples.en: He sent invitations to everyone in the class.
examples.cn: 他给班上每个人都发了请柬。

examples.en: The invitation arrived only two days before the dinner.
examples.cn: 请柬在晚宴前两天才到。

examples.en: Leaving the books outside was an invitation to rain.
examples.cn: 把书搁在门外，等于请雨来浇。

dict_mnemonic.text: invite（邀请）+ ation（名词）——请你来的那句话

root: 拉丁语 invitare「邀请、款待」→ invitatio「邀请」→ 古法语 → 英语 invitation。同族有 invite、inviting、uninvited。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: the request, the card that carries it, an offered chance, and something that attracts harm.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：邀请的请求、承载它的卡片、给出的机会，以及招来坏事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a card handed across a threshold by a smiling neighbour.
core.cn: 核心意象：邻居笑着隔着门槛递来一张卡片。

branches.en: THE WEDDING: a request to come and share a day.
branches.cn: 婚礼这条线：请你来共度一天。

branches.en: THE CARD: the printed object on the fridge.
branches.cn: 卡片这条线：贴在冰箱门上的实物。

branches.en: THE PAUSE: a silence that asks a question.
branches.cn: 停顿这条线：请求你发问的沉默。

branches.en: THE OPEN GATE: an invitation nobody meant to give.
branches.cn: 敞开的大门这条线：并非有意发出的邀请。

branches.en: THE LINK: both make room for someone else to act.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都给别人的行动让出位置。

intro.en: Invitation is the Latin noun on invitare, with the noun ending -ation.
intro.cn: invitation 是建立在 invitare 上的拉丁语名词，带词尾 -ation。

latinIntro.en: Latin invitare and invitatio are recorded forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 invitare 与 invitatio 均为记载形式。

items.example: The stem is debated by etymologists.
items.exampleCN: 词源学者对这个词干有争论。

items.example: The verb is the direct source.
The noun adds the abstract ending.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词加了抽象词尾。

definition_zh: 邀请；招待；招致（麻烦、批评）
definition_en: to ask someone to come somewhere or do something, or to make something likely to happen
core_image: 一扇门被推开，主人朝外伸出手做个「请进」的姿势
scene: 周末的厨房里炖着汤，主人擦擦手，走到门口朝对面的邻居招手。She invited the whole street to dinner.
sceneCN: 这里 invite 是「邀请」（第 1 个义项：请别人来），句意为她请了整条街的人来吃晚饭。画面里的物件：汤锅、门口、手巾。

pos.zh: 动词：邀请；招待；招致

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「邀请；邀请函」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「诱人的」
由本词加 -ee 构成，义为「被邀请者」
由本词加 -ional 构成，义为「邀请制的」

senses.title: Asking someone to come
senses.definition: to ask a person politely to come to an event or a place
senses.definitionCN: 礼貌地请人到某个活动或某个地方来
senses.example: They invited us to the wedding in June.
senses.exampleCN: 他们邀请我们参加六月的婚礼。
senses.why: Latin invitare meant "to ask, to entertain", with no need for a written card.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 invitare 意为「邀请、款待」，那时还不需要请柬。

senses.title: Offering hospitality
senses.definition: to receive someone as a guest and provide food or lodging
senses.definitionCN: 把某人当客人接来，并提供饭食或住处
senses.example: A neighbour invited the stranded family in for tea.
senses.exampleCN: 一位邻居把滞留的那家人请进屋喝茶。
senses.why: The same verb covers the welcome itself, not just the asking.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词也涵盖「招待」这件事，而不只是开口请。

senses.title: Bringing trouble on yourself
senses.definition: to make something bad or unwanted more likely by your own action
senses.definitionCN: 因为自己的举动让不好的事情更容易发生
senses.example: Leaving the gate open invites trouble at night.
senses.exampleCN: 夜里不关院门是会招来麻烦的。
senses.why: The "trouble" sense is the welcoming gesture aimed at something harmful.
senses.whyCN: 「招麻烦」义就是同一个欢迎手势，只是指向了有害的东西。

senses.title: Welcoming a response
senses.definition: to openly welcome comments, questions, or applications
senses.definitionCN: 公开表示乐于接受意见、提问或报名
senses.example: The paper invites readers to send in photographs.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报纸欢迎读者寄来照片。
senses.why: A request for replies is still an invitation, only written to many at once.
senses.whyCN: 征集回应仍是邀请，只不过一次写给许多人。

intro.en: Invite has kept its original meaning of asking and welcoming almost unchanged for two thousand years.
intro.cn: invite 两千年来几乎原封不动地保留了「邀请、款待」的原意。

items.en: invitare meant "to ask, to treat as a guest".
items.cn: invitare 意为「邀请、当客人款待」。

items.en: The noun invitatus recorded the welcoming of a guest.
items.cn: 名词 invitatus 记载了对客人的接待。

items.en: French had inviter, used for asking someone over.
items.cn: 法语有 inviter，用于请人过来。

items.en: English shortened the French verb to invite.
items.cn: 英语把法语动词缩成 invite。

items.en: The sense of inviting trouble grew from the idea of welcoming.
items.cn: 「招来麻烦」义从「迎接」的想法里长出来。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the invi- opening; the near-meaning group holds words for asking people in.
note.cn: 形近组共用 invi- 开头；近义组收表示请人进来的词。

entries.definition: A spoken or written request to come.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「邀请；请柬」，同族词。

entries.definition: To put money or effort in.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「投资」，开头相同。

entries.definition: To make something new.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「发明」，只差一个字母。

entries.definition: The general verb for requesting.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「请；问」，最泛。

entries.definition: To greet someone with pleasure.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「欢迎」，强调态度。

entries.definition: To order someone to come.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「传唤」，带命令色彩。

normalIntro.en: These hooks put the word at a door being held open.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它放在一扇被扶开的门口。

normal.en: The old verb invitare meant to ask and to treat well.
normal.cn: 古动词 invitare 既指邀请，也指好好招待。

normal.en: What arrives in the post is an invitation.
normal.cn: 寄到手里的东西叫 invitation。

normal.en: The person who receives it is the invitee.
normal.cn: 收到邀请的人叫 invitee。

normal.en: Leave a door open and you invite the wind.
normal.cn: 门留着不关，就是把风请进来。

normal.en: Invite a question and you are glad to hear it.
normal.cn: invite questions 就是欢迎别人提问。

abstract.en: Invitation is a door left open on purpose.
abstract.cn: 邀请就是一扇有意留开的门。

abstract.en: Whatever you welcome decides what follows you home.
abstract.cn: 你欢迎什么，什么就跟你回家。

abstract.en: Inviting trouble is the same gesture, aimed badly.
abstract.cn: 招麻烦是同一个手势，只是指错了方向。

examples.en: She invited two former students back to speak at the school.
examples.cn: 她请了两位往届学生回校演讲。

examples.en: The narrow path invites people to walk faster than they should.
examples.cn: 这条窄路会引诱人走得比该有的速度快。

examples.en: The magazine invites letters from readers of any age.
examples.cn: 这本杂志欢迎任何年龄的读者来信。

dict_mnemonic.text: in（进来）+ vite（拉丁 invitare 邀请）——请你进来

root: 拉丁语 invitare「邀请；款待」→ 古法语 inviter → 英语 invite。同族有 invitation、invitee、inviting。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: asking someone over, receiving a guest, drawing trouble, and welcoming replies.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：请人来、招待客人、招来麻烦，以及欢迎回应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand held out as the door opens.
core.cn: 核心意象：门开时伸出的那只手。

branches.en: THE CARD: a written or spoken request to come.
branches.cn: 请柬这条线：写出来或说出口的请。

branches.en: THE TABLE: food and shelter given to a guest.
branches.cn: 饭桌这条线：给客人的饭食与住处。

branches.en: THE GATE: an open entry that lets trouble in.
branches.cn: 院门这条线：留开的通道把麻烦放进来。

branches.en: THE OPENNESS: both senses come from a willing yes.
branches.cn: 敞开这条线：两个义项都源于一个乐意的「好」。

branches.en: THE RESULT: what you welcome decides what arrives.
branches.cn: 结果这条线：你欢迎什么，就决定什么到来。

intro.en: Invite keeps a single Latin stem, invit-, plus the verb ending -e.
intro.cn: invite 由一个拉丁词干 invit- 加动词尾 -e 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin invitare and invitatus are both recorded with the friendly sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 invitare 与 invitatus 均有记载，都带友好的意味。

items.example: The root survives in invite and invitation.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根仍见于 invite 与 invitation。

items.example: The verb is the direct source.
The participle shows the noun form.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词显示名词形式。

definition_zh: 铁；熨斗；熨烫；链条（复数）
definition_en: a strong grey metal, a heated tool for smoothing cloth, or the act of pressing clothes with it
core_image: 一块灰黑色的金属锭，旁边放着一台还冒着蒸汽的熨斗
scene: 洗衣房里蒸汽升起，她左手扶着衬衫，右手推着沉重的熨斗走过领口。The old gate is made of iron and has never rusted.
sceneCN: 这里 iron 是「铁」（第 1 个义项：那种金属），句意为这扇老门是铁做的，从来没有生锈。画面里的物件：熨斗、衬衫、蒸汽。

pos.zh: 名词：铁；熨斗；镣铐
动词：熨烫
形容词：铁的；坚强的

collocations.phrase: strike while the iron is hot

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「熨烫；要熨的衣物」
同以 iron 开头的形近词，义为「反讽」，词源不同
由本词加 ware 构成，义为「铁器」

senses.title: The metal
senses.definition: a hard grey metal used for tools, rails, and gates
senses.definitionCN: 一种坚硬灰暗的金属，用于工具、铁轨与大门
senses.example: The bridge was built with iron beams from the old mill.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥用了旧磨坊拆下来的铁梁。
senses.why: The metal sense is the oldest and stays attached to beams, rails, and gates.
senses.whyCN: 金属义最古老，至今仍与梁、轨、门连在一起。

senses.title: The smoothing tool
senses.definition: a flat heated tool used to press wrinkles out of cloth
senses.definitionCN: 一种扁平且加热的工具，用来压平布上的皱褶
senses.example: The iron was still hot when she put it down.
senses.exampleCN: 她放下熨斗时它还是烫的。
senses.why: The tool took the metal name because it was a block of iron heated over a fire.
senses.whyCN: 这个工具之所以借了金属的名字，因为它本是放在火上加热的铁块。

senses.title: Pressing clothes smooth
senses.definition: to press cloth with heat so that it lies flat
senses.definitionCN: 用热量压平布料
senses.example: He ironed his shirt five minutes before the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 面试前五分钟他才把衬衫熨好。
senses.why: The verb is simply the tool turned into an action.
senses.whyCN: 动词义就是把工具名直接变成动作。

senses.title: Chains and firm will
senses.definition: metal restraints, or metaphorically a hard and unyielding quality
senses.definitionCN: 金属镣铐，或比喻坚硬不屈的性质
senses.example: They spoke of the iron discipline of the mountain rescue team.
senses.exampleCN: 他们谈起山地救援队那种铁一般的纪律。
senses.why: From chains to character, the hard metal became a figure for what will not bend.
senses.whyCN: 从镣铐到性格，这种硬金属成了「不肯弯」的象征。

intro.en: Iron is an old Germanic word; its distant origin is uncertain, though Celtic is a strong candidate.
intro.cn: iron 是个古老的日耳曼词，更远的来源不确定，凯尔特语是较有力的候选。

items.en: The word appears as isern or iren in early texts.
items.cn: 这个词在早期文献中写作 isern 或 iren。

items.en: Related forms include German Eisen and Old Saxon isarn.
items.cn: 同源形式包括德语 Eisen 与古撒克逊语 isarn。

items.en: The deeper root may come from a Celtic metal word, but it is disputed.
items.cn: 更深层词根可能来自凯尔特语的金属词，但仍有争议。

items.en: Middle English changed the -s- to -r-, giving iren.
items.cn: 中古英语把 -s- 变成 -r-，写作 iren。

items.en: Modern English settled on iron for both the metal and the tool.
items.cn: 现代英语把 iron 固定下来，兼指金属与熨斗。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the iron spelling; the near-meaning group holds words for metals and pressing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 iron 拼写；近义组收表示金属与压平动作的词。

entries.definition: Saying the opposite of what you mean.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「反讽」，拼写相近但词源不同。

entries.definition: The plural, or chains for a prisoner.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为复数，也可指镣铐。

entries.definition: The activity of pressing clothes.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「熨烫」，同族词。

entries.definition: Iron hardened with carbon.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「钢」，铁与碳的合金。

entries.definition: To push down or flatten with force.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「压」，压平的动作。

entries.definition: To make a surface even.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「使平整」，结果导向。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie together the metal, the tool, and the act of pressing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把金属、工具和压平这个动作串起来。

normal.en: One word, one metal, one heavy tool.
normal.cn: 一个词，既是金属，也是那件沉工具。

normal.en: An iron is heavy because it is iron.
normal.cn: 熨斗沉，正是因为它就是铁。

normal.en: To iron is to press with that weight.
normal.cn: iron 作动词就是拿这份重量去压。

normal.en: German Eisen is a cousin from the same family.
normal.cn: 德语 Eisen 是同族的表亲。

normal.en: The -r- came late; early English said isern.
normal.cn: 那个 -r- 是后来才有，早先英语说 isern。

abstract.en: Iron is a metal that remembers the shape you give it.
abstract.cn: 铁是会记住你所给形状的金属。

abstract.en: An iron is iron made gentle by heat.
abstract.cn: 熨斗是被热软化过的铁。

abstract.en: Iron will is the metal kept uncooled.
abstract.cn: 铁一般的意志，是不肯冷却的金属。

examples.en: The locket is silver, but the chain is iron.
examples.cn: 坠子是银的，链子却是铁的。

examples.en: She ironed the curtains before hanging them again.
examples.cn: 她先把窗帘熨好再重新挂上。

examples.en: The prisoners wore irons on their ankles.
examples.cn: 囚犯脚踝上带着镣铐。

dict_mnemonic.text: iron 既是铁，也是拿铁做的熨斗，最后成了熨衣服

root: 古英语 isern / iren（日耳曼语词）→ 中古英语 iren → 现代英语 iron。同源有德语 Eisen；更深层来源可能来自凯尔特语，尚无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: the metal, the smoothing tool, pressing clothes, and chains or an unyielding will.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：金属铁、熨斗、熨衣服，以及镣铐或钢铁般的意志。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grey metal heavy enough to press cloth flat.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块沉得足以把布压平的灰色金属。

branches.en: THE BEAM: metal bent into bridges and gates.
branches.cn: 铁梁这条线：被弯成桥梁与大门的金属。

branches.en: THE TOOL: the same metal given a handle and heat.
branches.cn: 工具这条线：同一块金属加上把手和热。

branches.en: THE ACT: pressing cloth until wrinkles go.
branches.cn: 动作这条线：把布压到皱褶消失。

branches.en: THE STRENGTH: hardness is both material and metaphor.
branches.cn: 坚硬这条线：硬度既是材质也是比喻。

branches.en: THE HAND: the tool and the act are one idea.
branches.cn: 手这条线：工具和动作本是同一个意思。

intro.en: Iron has no prefix or suffix to cut off; it is a whole Germanic root whose origin is debated.
intro.cn: iron 没有可切分的前后缀，它是一个来源有争议的完整日耳曼词根。

latinIntro.en: There is no secure Latin source, so latinEntries stays empty; Latin ferrum "iron" is unrelated.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有可靠的拉丁语来源，所以 latinEntries 留空；拉丁语 ferrum「铁」并不同源。

items.example: It forms irons, also used for chains.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 irons，也用来指镣铐。

items.example: The compound joins iron to ware.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词把 iron 与 ware 连起来。
另一个复合词，指一种行当。

items.example: It starts with the same letters but is unrelated in origin.
items.exampleCN: 开头字母相同，却不同源。

items.example: The earlier spelling shows the lost -s-.
items.exampleCN: 较早的写法显示那个消失的 -s-。

items.example: The compound keeps the metal image.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词保留了金属的意象。

definition_zh: 岛；岛屿；安全岛；孤立的群体
definition_en: a piece of land with water all around it, or anything that stands alone surrounded by something else
core_image: 一圈水把一块陆地围在中央，四周望不到岸
scene: 渡轮驶过一片平静的海面，远处出现一小块被水围住的绿色陆地。A single island appeared on the horizon before sunset.
sceneCN: 这里 island 是「岛屿」（第 1 个义项：四面环水的陆地），句意为日落前地平线上出现了一座孤岛。画面里的物件：渡轮、海面、地平线。

pos.zh: 名词：岛；岛屿；安全岛；孤立之地

derivatives.zh: 由 island 加 -er 构成，义为「岛民」
由古法语 islette 借入，是 island 的指小形式，义为「小岛」
与 island 同源的借词，义为「小岛」，多用于地名

senses.title: Land surrounded by water
senses.definition: a piece of land smaller than a continent, completely surrounded by water
senses.definitionCN: 比大陆小、四面被水包围的陆地
senses.example: The island is reachable only by boat.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛只能坐船到达。
senses.why: The geographic sense is the central one and the only one the Old English word named.
senses.whyCN: 地理义是核心，也是古英语时期这个词唯一指的意思。

senses.title: A raised area in a road
senses.definition: a raised or marked area in the middle of a road where pedestrians can wait
senses.definitionCN: 马路中间供行人等候的高起或划线区域
senses.example: Wait on the traffic island until the light turns green.
senses.exampleCN: 在交通岛上等绿灯再走。
senses.why: A safety island is a patch of ground cut off by streams of traffic, exactly like land in water.
senses.whyCN: 安全岛是被车流围住的一小块地，和水中陆地是同一个画面。

senses.title: A detached group
senses.definition: a group of people or things standing apart from everything around them
senses.definitionCN: 与周围完全隔开的一群人或物
senses.example: The village became an island of old customs in a modern city.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子成了现代城市里一座旧习俗的孤岛。
senses.why: The metaphor transfers surrounding water to surrounding difference, leaving the group alone.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把四周的水换成四周的差异，于是这群人显得孤立。

senses.title: A kitchen unit standing alone
senses.definition: a counter or work surface standing free in the middle of a kitchen
senses.definitionCN: 立在厨房中央、四周不与墙相连的操作台
senses.example: The new kitchen has a marble island for chopping.
senses.exampleCN: 新厨房有一个大理石岛台用来切菜。
senses.why: The counter is surrounded by open floor instead of water, but it still stands alone.
senses.whyCN: 岛台被空出来的地面而不是水围着，但仍然是孤零零立着的。

senses.title: An isolated rise of tissue
senses.definition: a small separate patch of cells or tissue of one kind inside another kind
senses.definitionCN: 一种组织中被另一类组织包围的小块区域
senses.example: The scan showed a tiny island of healthy cells.
senses.exampleCN: 扫描显示有一小片健康的细胞岛。
senses.why: Medical usage keeps the shape of one kind of material surrounded by a different one.
senses.whyCN: 医学用法保留了「一种物质被另一种包围」的形状。

intro.en: Island is an English word whose modern spelling was reshaped by confusion with Latin insula; the s is silent because of that error.
intro.cn: island 是英语本土词，现代拼写受拉丁语 insula 的误认影响而改写，s 不发音正来自这场误会。

items.en: The native word was igland, from ieg, "island", and land.
items.cn: 本土形式是 igland，由 ieg「岛」与 land 构成。

items.en: ieg itself could also mean a piece of low ground near water.
items.cn: ieg 本身也可指水边的一片低地。

items.en: The form shifted toward iland, and the s was later inserted by false association.
items.cn: 中古英语时期写作 iland，后来因错误联想被插入了 s。

items.en: Latin insula, "island", supplied the model for adding that s.
items.cn: 拉丁语 insula「岛」提供了加这个 s 的模型。

items.en: The spelling island was fixed in print, while the s stayed silent.
items.cn: island 的拼写在印刷中固定下来，而 s 始终不发音。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words with the silent s or the isl- shape; the near-meaning group holds land forms and water terms.
note.cn: 形近组收含不发音 s 或 isl- 形状的词；近义组收地貌与水域相关词。

entries.definition: A small island, now mostly in names.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「小岛」，与 island 同源的借词。

entries.definition: A very small island.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「小岛」，是 isle 的指小形式。

entries.definition: The plural of isle, with the same silent s.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「岛屿（复数）」，与 isle 一起显示不发音的 s，拼写相近。

entries.definition: Land almost surrounded by water but joined to the mainland.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「半岛」，三面是水一面连陆。

entries.definition: A group of islands.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「群岛」，是许多岛的组合。

entries.definition: A ridge of rock or coral near the water surface.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「礁」，不是陆地而是水下的隆起。

normalIntro.en: These hooks connect the native igland, the false Latin s, and the island images of roads and kitchens.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把本土词 igland、误加的拉丁 s，以及马路与厨房里的岛连在一起。

normal.en: Old English igland combined ieg and land.
normal.cn: 古英语 igland 由 ieg 与 land 组合而成。

normal.en: The s in island is silent because it was wrongly inserted.
normal.cn: island 里的 s 因误加而不发音。

normal.en: Latin insula named a house for several families in Rome.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 insula 在罗马指一栋住多户的房子。

normal.en: An islander lives on an island.
normal.cn: islander 就是住在岛上的人。

normal.en: A traffic island stands between two lanes.
normal.cn: 交通岛立在两条车道之间。

abstract.en: An island is land that water has agreed to surround.
abstract.cn: 岛是水同意包围起来的一块地。

abstract.en: Every safe island is a pause in a moving stream.
abstract.cn: 每一个安全岛都是车流里的一次停顿。

abstract.en: A kitchen island is a place for work in the middle of open floor.
abstract.cn: 厨房岛台是空地上的一个工作点。

examples.en: The island has no cars and only one shop.
examples.cn: 这座岛没有汽车，只有一家店。

examples.en: Children wait on the traffic island before crossing.
examples.cn: 孩子们在交通岛上等候过马路。

examples.en: Her office was an island of quiet in a noisy building.
examples.cn: 她的办公室在吵闹的大楼里是一片安静的孤岛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱拦岛」—— 海把这块地爱拦在怀里，不让它离开

root: 古英语 ieg「岛；水边低地」+ land → igland → iland → island（受拉丁 insula 影响插入不发音的 s）。同族有 isle、islet、islander。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: land in water, a road island, a detached group, a kitchen island, and a patch of tissue.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：水中陆地、交通岛、孤立的群体、厨房岛台，以及组织孤岛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a patch of land held in a ring of water.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块被水圈住的陆地。

branches.en: THE HORIZON: green land seen from a ferry.
branches.cn: 地平线这条线：从渡轮上望见的绿陆地。

branches.en: THE ROAD: a raised patch between lanes.
branches.cn: 马路这条线：车道之间的高起小块。

branches.en: THE VILLAGE: old customs kept apart from a city.
branches.cn: 村子这条线：与城市隔开的旧习俗。

branches.en: THE KITCHEN: a counter standing in open floor.
branches.cn: 厨房这条线：立在空地里的操作台。

branches.en: THE SCAN: a separate patch of cells.
branches.cn: 扫描这条线：另成一块的细胞。

intro.en: Island is a compound of two Old English elements; English endings do the rest.
intro.cn: island 由两个古英语成分复合而成，其余由英语词尾完成。

latinIntro.en: Latin insula influenced only the spelling, not the origin, yet its relatives are worth listing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 insula 只影响了拼写而非来源，但它的同族词值得列出。

items.example: The stem of insular and isolate.
items.exampleCN: insular 与 isolate 的词干。

items.example: It forms island life and island nation.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 island life 与 island nation。

definition_zh: 它；（指时间、天气、距离等）；（作形式主语或形式宾语）；重要的人
definition_en: the thing or animal already mentioned, used as a pronoun for things and for time, weather, and distance
core_image: 手指一点，点中桌上一只说不上名字的东西
scene: 桌上放着一个旧盒子，谁都没打开过。Nobody knows what is inside it.
sceneCN: 这里 it 是「它」（第 1 个义项：指代上文提到的物品），句意为没人知道它里面是什么。画面里的物件：旧盒子、桌面。

pos.zh: 代词：它；这；那
名词：重要的人或事；时髦

derivatives.zh: 由 it 加 s 构成，义为「它的」，作定语
由 it 加 self 构成，义为「它自己」

senses.title: The thing already mentioned
senses.definition: used to refer to a thing, animal, or idea that has already been mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 用来指上文已经提到的物品、动物或想法
senses.example: I found the key and put it in my pocket.
senses.exampleCN: 我找到钥匙，把它放进口袋。
senses.why: The third person pronoun for things is the oldest and simplest use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 指物的第三人称代词是这个词最古老也最简单的用法。

senses.title: Time, weather, and distance
senses.definition: used as an empty subject when talking about time, weather, temperature, or distance
senses.definitionCN: 谈论时间、天气、温度或距离时作没有实际含义的主语
senses.example: It is already dark outside.
senses.exampleCN: 外面已经黑了。
senses.why: English needs a subject in every sentence, so an empty it holds the place of time and weather.
senses.whyCN: 英语每句都要有主语，于是空主语的 it 占住了时间与天气的位置。

senses.title: A formal subject or object
senses.definition: used as a placeholder subject or object before the real clause or infinitive
senses.definitionCN: 在真正的主语或宾语从句、不定式前占位的虚词
senses.example: It is hard to say goodbye.
senses.exampleCN: 说再见是件难事。
senses.why: The real subject is the clause at the end, and it simply marks the seat until it arrives.
senses.whyCN: 真正的主语在后面那个从句，it 只是先占座，等它到来。

senses.title: A situation in general
senses.definition: used to refer to a situation or state of affairs already understood
senses.definitionCN: 用来指已经明了的情况或局面
senses.example: It has been like this for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这种情况已经持续多年了。
senses.why: A whole situation can be treated as one thing, so the pronoun covers more than a single object.
senses.whyCN: 整个局面可以当成一个东西看，于是这个代词涵盖的不止一件物体。

senses.title: A person of importance
senses.definition: used in informal speech for a person who is thought to be important or fashionable
senses.definitionCN: 口语中用来指被认为重要或时髦的人
senses.example: She thinks she is it after the promotion.
senses.exampleCN: 升职之后她觉得自己很了不起。
senses.why: Calling a person it says they are the one, the single notable thing in view.
senses.whyCN: 把一个人称作 it，等于说他们就是那个唯一显眼的存在。

senses.title: A game of tag
senses.definition: used as the name of the children's chasing game, and for the player who must chase
senses.definitionCN: 用作儿童追逐游戏的名称，也指负责追的人
senses.example: The children played it in the playground until dark.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在操场上玩抓人游戏直到天黑。
senses.why: The game name comes from the bare pronoun, the chased one simply being it.
senses.whyCN: 游戏名直接来自这个代词，被追的那个人就是「它」。

intro.en: It is the native English third person pronoun for things, recorded from Old English hit.
intro.cn: it 是英语本土的第三人称指物代词，古英语时期写作 hit。

items.en: The form was hit, with the h pronounced.
items.cn: 古英语形式是 hit，开头的 h 要发音。

items.en: Germanic relatives include Dutch het and German es.
items.cn: 日耳曼亲属有荷兰语 het 与德语 es。

items.en: The h was lost in unstressed speech, leaving it.
items.cn: 中古英语中 h 在弱读时脱落，剩下 it。

items.en: It became the fixed pronoun for things and animals.
items.cn: it 固定为指物与动物的代词。

items.en: Empty uses for time, weather, and formal subjects spread in later prose.
items.cn: 指时间天气与作形式主语的用法在近代散文中普及。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short it- shape; the near-meaning group holds the other pronouns of reference.
note.cn: 形近组都是 it 开头的短词形；近义组收其余指代代词。

entries.definition: Belonging to it.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 s 构成，义为「它的」，同族代词。

entries.definition: The same thing, emphatically.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 self 构成，义为「它自己」。

entries.definition: A single thing on a list.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「条目」，拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: The thing here near the speaker.
entries.definitionCN: 指示代词义为「这个」，指近处。

entries.definition: The thing further from the speaker.
entries.definitionCN: 指示代词义为「那个」，指远处。

entries.definition: The things or people already mentioned, as a plural.
entries.definitionCN: 代词义为「它们、他们」，是 it 的复数。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from the Old English hit to the empty it of weather and formal subjects.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从古英语 hit 走到天气与形式主语里的空 it。

normal.en: Old English hit lost its h to become it.
normal.cn: 古英语 hit 掉了 h 变成 it。

normal.en: Its and itself are built from it.
normal.cn: its 与 itself 都由 it 构成。

normal.en: Make it means to succeed or to arrive in time.
normal.cn: make it 意为成功或及时赶到。

normal.en: It is the empty subject of weather sentences.
normal.cn: it 是天气句里的空主语。

normal.en: German es and Dutch het are cousins.
normal.cn: 德语 es 与荷兰语 het 是它的亲属。

abstract.en: It is a finger pointing at the thing already named.
abstract.cn: it 是指向已说出那件东西的手指。

abstract.en: An empty it keeps the seat warm for a long clause.
abstract.cn: 空主语的 it 替长从句先把座位暖着。

abstract.en: In tag, whoever is it must run.
abstract.cn: 在抓人游戏里，被称作 it 的人就得跑。

examples.en: The box is heavy, so lift it carefully.
examples.cn: 这个箱子很重，搬的时候小心点。

examples.en: It is raining again this afternoon.
examples.cn: 今天下午又下雨了。

examples.en: It is not easy to learn a new language.
examples.cn: 学一门新语言并不容易。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一特」—— 手指一伸，特指桌上那一件东西

root: 古英语 hit（第三人称指物代词，h 发音）→ 中古英语脱落 h → 现代英语 it。同族有 its、itself。

sensesIntro.en: Six uses: the thing mentioned, empty subject for time and weather, formal subject or object, a general situation, an important person, and the game of tag.
sensesIntro.cn: 六种用法：指已提到的物品、时间天气的空主语、形式主语或宾语、泛指情况、重要人物，以及抓人游戏。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger pointing at one unnamed thing on the table.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指点住桌上那件说不清名字的东西。

branches.en: THE KEY: one item already named in the sentence.
branches.cn: 钥匙这条线：句子里已经点过的物件。

branches.en: THE WEATHER: an empty seat before the real subject.
branches.cn: 天气这条线：真主语到来前的空座。

branches.en: THE YEARS: one long situation treated as a single thing.
branches.cn: 年月这条线：把长局面当成一件事。

branches.en: THE OFFICE: a person who thinks she is the one.
branches.cn: 办公室这条线：自认独一无二的人。

branches.en: THE PLAYGROUND: the child who must chase.
branches.cn: 操场这条线：必须去追人的那个孩子。

intro.en: It is a bare Germanic pronoun; the longer forms are made with English pieces.
intro.cn: it 是一个单独的日耳曼语代词，长形式由英语成分构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so latinEntries is empty; the Latin pronoun for it is listed only for contrast in grammar.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源，所以 latinEntries 留空，只在语法上作对照。

items.example: The h was dropped in Middle English.
It has no apostrophe in its.
It reveals nothing in it rains.
items.exampleCN: it rains 里的 it 不指任何东西。

definition_zh: 它的；其
definition_en: belonging to or connected with a thing or animal that has already been mentioned
core_image: 手指从别的东西移回那只盒子，示意盒盖是它的
scene: 客栈门外，客人看了看墙上的招牌和招牌下面那扇半开的门。The old inn has kept its wooden sign for a century.
sceneCN: 这里 its 是「它的」（第 1 个义项：指属于前面提到的事物），句意为这家老客栈一个世纪来一直保留着它那块木招牌。画面里的物件：招牌、半开的门、石墙。

pos.zh: 代词：它的；其（作定语）

derivatives.zh: its 的基础代词，义为「它」
由 it 加 self 构成，义为「它自己」

senses.title: Belonging to a thing
senses.definition: belonging to or connected with a thing, animal, or idea already mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 属于上文提到的物品、动物或想法
senses.example: The company changed its name last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司去年改了名字。
senses.why: Its is simply it plus a possessive ending, used before a noun.
senses.whyCN: its 就是 it 加所有格词尾，用在名词前。

senses.title: Belonging to an animal
senses.definition: belonging to an animal whose sex is unknown or not important
senses.definitionCN: 属于一只性别不明或不重要的动物
senses.example: The dog wagged its tail when the door opened.
senses.exampleCN: 门一开，那只狗就摇起了尾巴。
senses.why: English avoids he or she for animals by default, so its covers them all.
senses.whyCN: 英语默认不用 he 或 she 指动物，于是 its 把动物都涵盖了。

senses.title: Belonging to a baby
senses.definition: used for a baby or small child before the sex is known in the sentence
senses.definitionCN: 在句子里尚未指明性别时用来指婴儿或幼儿
senses.example: The baby dropped its toy and began to cry.
senses.exampleCN: 婴儿把玩具掉了，开始哭起来。
senses.why: The same gap that hides an animal's sex also hides a baby's, so its fills in.
senses.whyCN: 藏在动物身上的性别空白也同样出现在婴儿身上，于是用 its 填补。

senses.title: A part of a whole
senses.definition: used for a part, member, or feature of an organisation, place, or system
senses.definitionCN: 指机构、地方或系统的组成部分、成员或特征
senses.example: The city is proud of its bridges.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市为它的桥梁感到自豪。
senses.why: An organisation is treated as one thing, and its parts belong to that thing.
senses.whyCN: 机构被当成一个整体，它的各个部分就属于这个整体。

senses.title: An abstract owner
senses.definition: used for something that belongs to an idea, quality, or event mentioned earlier
senses.definitionCN: 指属于前面提到的想法、性质或事件的东西
senses.example: The plan failed because of its cost.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划因成本而失败。
senses.why: Abstract nouns take the same possessive, since grammar does not ask whether the owner is solid.
senses.whyCN: 抽象名词用同一个所有格，因为语法不问拥有者是否摸得着。

intro.en: Its is a form made inside English from it plus a possessive ending; it has no separate ancient source.
intro.cn: its 是英语内部用 it 加所有格词尾造出的形式，没有独立的古老词源。

items.en: The pronoun appeared as hit, and its older possessive was his.
items.cn: 当时的代词是 hit，旧有的所有格用的是 his。

items.en: The h was lost, and the form it spread in ordinary speech.
items.cn: 中古英语丢了 h，it 在口语中普及。

items.en: Its appeared in writing in the sixteenth century as a new possessive.
items.cn: its 在十六世纪作为新的所有格出现在书面语中。

items.en: Early writers avoided its, and the Authorised Version of the Bible has none of it.
items.cn: 早期作者回避 its，钦定本圣经里一次也没用。

items.en: The apostrophe was never added, so its differs from it's on purpose.
items.cn: 词里始终不加撇号，所以 its 与 it's 是有意区分的。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on it plus an ending; the near-meaning group holds other possessives.
note.cn: 形近组都由 it 加词尾构成；近义组收其他所有格代词。

entries.definition: The short form of it is or it has.
entries.definitionCN: 缩写形式，意为「它是」或「它有」，与 its 同音但多撇号。

entries.definition: The same thing, referred to reflexively.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词根 it 加 self 构成，义为「它自己」。

entries.definition: The base pronoun for a thing.
entries.definitionCN: 基础代词，义为「它」，its 由它加词尾而来。

entries.definition: Belonging to a male person or animal.
entries.definitionCN: 所有格代词，义为「他的」，旧英语也用它指 it。

entries.definition: Belonging to several people or things.
entries.definitionCN: 所有格代词，义为「它们的」，用于复数。

entries.definition: Belonging to which person or thing.
entries.definitionCN: 疑问与关系所有格，义为「谁的」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks separate its from it's and place the form in the story of hit and his.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把 its 与 it's 分开，并把这一形式放回 hit 与 his 的历史里。

normal.en: Its is it plus a possessive ending, with no apostrophe.
normal.cn: its 是 it 加所有格词尾，不带撇号。

normal.en: It's always means it is or it has.
normal.cn: it's 永远表示它是或它有。

normal.en: Old English used his even for things.
normal.cn: 古英语连指物都用 his。

normal.en: Its first appeared in print in the sixteenth century.
normal.cn: its 在十六世纪才出现在印刷品里。

normal.en: Its own stresses that the owner is the thing itself.
normal.cn: its own 强调拥有者正是那件东西本身。

abstract.en: Its points back at the last thing in the sentence and says, mine.
abstract.cn: its 回指句子里最后那件东西，说声「我的」。

abstract.en: No apostrophe, because its is not a shortened sentence.
abstract.cn: 不加撇号，因为 its 不是句子的缩写。

abstract.en: An animal keeps its tail with the same little word.
abstract.cn: 动物也用这个小词保住它的尾巴。

examples.en: The film lost its charm after the first hour.
examples.cn: 这部影片在第一个小时后失去了魅力。

examples.en: The cat licked its paw and went back to sleep.
examples.cn: 猫舔了舔爪子又睡回去。

examples.en: The school celebrated its hundredth year.
examples.cn: 这所学校庆祝了它的第一百个年头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一件寺」—— 一座庙，说的是它自己那件东西

root: 古英语 hit（指物代词，旧所有格为 his）→ 中古英语脱 h 成 it → 十六世纪英语加 -s 造出 its。同族有 it、itself。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses: belonging to a thing, an animal, a baby, an organisation, or an abstract idea.
sensesIntro.cn: 五种用法：属于物品、动物、婴儿、机构，或抽象事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger moving from another thing back to the box, claiming it.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指从别处移回那只盒子，宣布它归自己。

branches.en: THE COMPANY: one name changed, one owner.
branches.cn: 公司这条线：改掉名字的是它自己。

branches.en: THE DOG: a tail that belongs to no named sex.
branches.cn: 狗这条线：一条不属于任何性别的尾巴。

branches.en: THE BABY: a toy dropped before the sex matters.
branches.cn: 婴儿这条线：性别未明时掉下的玩具。

branches.en: THE CITY: bridges that belong to a whole.
branches.cn: 城市这条线：属于整体的那些桥。

branches.en: THE PLAN: a cost that belongs to an idea.
branches.cn: 计划这条线：属于一个想法的成本。

intro.en: Its is a short English form; the ending is the only piece added to it.
intro.cn: its 是一个简短的英语形式，唯一的构件是加在 it 后面的词尾。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source for its, so latinEntries is empty.
latinIntro.cn: its 没有拉丁语来源，因此 latinEntries 留空。

items.exampleCN: 它把 it 变成 its。

items.example: It forms itself, not its self.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 itself，而非分开写。

items.example: It belongs to it's, a contraction.
items.exampleCN: 它属于缩写 it's，与本词不同。

definition_zh: 它自己；自身；（用于强调）本身
definition_en: used to show that a thing is the same one already mentioned, or to give emphasis to that thing
core_image: 镜子立在一件物体前，镜内镜外是同一样东西
scene: 孩子第一次看到镜中的自己，伸手去摸，镜子发出轻轻的一声响。The old machine started itself after the power came back.
sceneCN: 这里 itself 是「它自己」（第 1 个义项：指同一个事物，动作回到自身），句意为来电后那台旧机器自己启动了。画面里的物件：镜子、控制面板、指示灯。

pos.zh: 代词：它自己；自身；（加强语气）本身

derivatives.zh: itself 的基础代词，义为「它」
由 it 加 s 构成，义为「它的」
itself 的组成部分，义为「自身」

senses.title: The same thing acts
senses.definition: used when the thing already mentioned is the one doing or receiving the action
senses.definitionCN: 当已提到的事物本身是动作的发出者或承受者时使用
senses.example: The door closed itself in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 门被风吹得自己关上了。
senses.why: Self turns the pronoun back on its own subject, so the actor and the object are one.
senses.whyCN: self 把代词折回到主语身上，于是施动者和受动者是同一个。

senses.title: Emphasis on a thing
senses.definition: used to stress that this thing, and not another, is meant
senses.definitionCN: 强调所指正是这件东西而不是别的
senses.example: The building itself is old, but the inside is new.
senses.exampleCN: 这座建筑本身很旧，里面却是新的。
senses.why: Emphatic use points at the thing bare, as if removing everything around it.
senses.whyCN: 强调用法直指那件东西本身，仿佛把周围都去掉了。

senses.title: Acting without help
senses.definition: used with by to show that nobody else was involved
senses.definitionCN: 与 by 连用，表示没有别人参与
senses.example: The child can dress itself now.
senses.exampleCN: 这孩子现在能自己穿衣服了。
senses.why: By itself pushes the self-image to its limit: no helper is in the picture.
senses.whyCN: by itself 把「自己」推到极限：画面里没有任何帮手。

senses.title: Being the essence
senses.definition: used with in to say what something is when considered alone
senses.definitionCN: 与 in 连用，表示单看它本身的性质
senses.example: The offer is not bad in itself, but the timing is wrong.
senses.exampleCN: 这个提议本身不坏，只是时机不对。
senses.why: In itself takes the thing out of its context and looks at it alone.
senses.whyCN: in itself 把这件东西从情境里拿出来单独看。

senses.title: Returning to a state
senses.definition: used to say that a thing or person has come back to its normal state
senses.definitionCN: 表示某物或某人回到了常态
senses.example: The market slowly righted itself after the shock.
senses.exampleCN: 市场在冲击之后慢慢恢复过来。
senses.why: Something that rights itself has folded back to where it began.
senses.whyCN: 能一下扶正自己的东西，是折回了原来的位置。

intro.en: Itself is a compound made in English from it and self, after the pattern of himself and herself.
intro.cn: itself 是英语内部用 it 与 self 复合而成，模仿了 himself 与 herself 的模式。

items.en: Self was a separate noun and adjective for the same very person.
items.cn: self 原来自成名词和形容词，表示「正是本人」。

items.en: The pronoun was hit, so the compound shape came later.
items.cn: 当时的代词是 hit，所以这种复合形式出现较晚。

items.en: Reflexive forms such as himself and herself were already common.
items.cn: 反身形式如 himself、herself 已很常见。

items.en: Itself appeared as it replaced hit in ordinary speech.
items.cn: it 取代 hit 之后，itself 才出现。

items.en: The by itself and in itself phrases fixed in modern usage.
items.cn: by itself 与 in itself 这些说法在现代用法里固定下来。

note.en: The look-alike group is the it- family with self; the near-meaning group holds other reflexive pronouns.
note.cn: 形近组是 it 加 self 的词族；近义组收其他反身代词。

entries.definition: Belonging to it.
entries.definitionCN: 所有格形式，义为「它的」，与本词只差 self。

entries.definition: The pronoun for a thing.
entries.definitionCN: 基础代词，义为「它」，是本词的前半。

entries.definition: A person's own nature or body.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「自身」，是本词的后半。

entries.definition: Those same things or people, as a plural.
entries.definitionCN: 反身代词，义为「它们自己」，用于复数。

entries.definition: That same male person.
entries.definitionCN: 反身代词，义为「他自己」，itself 的模仿对象。

entries.definition: That same female person.
entries.definitionCN: 反身代词，义为「她自己」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the mirror image and the three fixed phrases by itself, in itself, and for itself.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子用镜子画面，以及 by itself、in itself、for itself 三个固定说法。

normal.en: Itself is it plus self, like himself and herself.
normal.cn: itself 就是 it 加 self，与 himself、herself 同构。

normal.en: Self was once a separate word for the very person.
normal.cn: self 原先是表示「正是本人」的独立词。

normal.en: By itself means with nobody's help.
normal.cn: by itself 意为没有别人帮忙。

normal.en: In itself means considered alone.
normal.cn: in itself 意为单看它本身。

normal.en: Reflexive forms appeared after it replaced hit.
normal.cn: 反身形式是在 it 取代 hit 之后才有的。

abstract.en: Itself is a mirror in front of the thing.
abstract.cn: itself 就是立在那东西面前的一面镜子。

abstract.en: The machine that starts itself needs no hand.
abstract.cn: 会自己启动的机器不需要人的手。

abstract.en: What is old in itself may still be new inside.
abstract.cn: 本身很旧的东西，里面仍可能是新的。

examples.en: The problem will not solve itself.
examples.cn: 这个问题不会自己解决。

examples.en: The house itself is small, but the garden is huge.
examples.cn: 房子本身不大，但花园很大。

examples.en: The lamp switches itself off at midnight.
examples.cn: 这盏灯到午夜会自动关掉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一特塞奥夫」—— 一件东西特意把自己塞回自己身边

root: 古英语 self「本人；自身」（独立词）→ 中古英语 himself、herself 等反身形式 → 现代英语 it 加 self 构成 itself。同族有 it、its、self。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses: the same thing acting, emphatic itself, acting alone, considered in essence, and returning to a normal state.
